newsitem.title: FINLAND: KONECRANES WINS $10 MLN U.S. CRANES ORDER.
newsitem.headline: KONECRANES WINS $10 MLN U.S. CRANES ORDER.

text.p: Finnish industrial cranes maker KCI Konecranes International Oy said on Tuesday it won a $10 million order for rubber-tyred gantry cranes (RTG) from the South Carolina State Ports Authority in the United States.
The cranes would be delivered to three different locations within 12 months, Konecranes said.
"This deal is our largest commercial breakthrough in this field and an especially important achievement in the highly competed U.S. market," Konecranes CEO Stig Gustavson said in the statement.
